passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: The park is nearby, and I go there often.
phrases.ko: 공원은 우리 집 가까이에 있고, 나는 자주 가요.
phrases.zh: 公园就在附近，我常常去。
phrases.py: gōng yuán jiù zài fù jìn， wǒ cháng cháng qù。

phrases.en: There are many trees, and the grass is green.
phrases.zh: 那里有许多树，草是绿色的。
phrases.py: nà lǐ yǒu xǔ duō shù， cǎo shì lǜ sè de。

phrases.en: I sit on a bench and watch a bird.
phrases.zh: 我坐在板凳上看一只鸟。
phrases.py: wǒ zuò zài bǎn dèng shàng kàn yī zhī niǎo。

phrases.en: I walk on the path with my little sister.
phrases.py: wǒ hé mèi mèi zǒu zài xiǎo lù shàng。

phrases.en: I see a flower, and I play on the swing.
phrases.zh: 我看见一朵花，也去荡秋千。
phrases.py: wǒ kàn jiàn yī duǒ huā， yě qù dàng qiū qiān。

phrases.en: The green grass is soft under my shoes.
phrases.zh: 绿色的草在我的鞋下很柔软。
phrases.py: lǜ sè de cǎo zài wǒ de xié xià hěn róu ruǎn。

phrases.en: A bird sings in the tree.
phrases.py: yī zhī niǎo zài shù shàng chàng gē。

phrases.en: My brother plays ball along the path.
phrases.ko: 오빠는 길을 따라 공을 가지고 놀아요.
phrases.py: gē gē yán zhe xiǎo lù wán qiú。

phrases.en: We like this park because it is nearby.
phrases.zh: 我们喜欢这个公园，因为它就在附近。
phrases.py: wǒ men xǐ huān zhè ge gōng yuán， yīn wèi tā jiù zài fù jìn。

phrases.en: I rest on the bench when I am tired.
phrases.zh: 我累了就在板凳上休息。
phrases.py: wǒ lèi le jiù zài bǎn dèng shàng xiū xī。

phrases.en: The park is my favorite place after school.
phrases.ko: 공원은 방과 후에 내가 가장 좋아하는 곳이에요.
phrases.zh: 公园是我放学后最喜欢的地方。
phrases.py: gōng yuán shì wǒ fàng xué hòu zuì xǐ huān de dì fāng。

full_passage_spoken: The park is nearby, and I go there often. There are many trees, and the grass is green. I sit on a bench and watch a bird. I walk on the path with my little sister. I see a flower, and I play on the swing. The green grass is soft under my shoes. A bird sings in the tree. My brother plays ball along the path. We like this park because it is nearby. I rest on the bench when I am tired. The park is my favorite place after school.
full_passage_zh: 公园就在附近，我常常去。那里有许多树，草是绿色的。我坐在板凳上看一只鸟。我和妹妹走在小路上。我看见一朵花，也去荡秋千。绿色的草在我的鞋下很柔软。一只鸟在树上唱歌。哥哥沿着小路玩球。我们喜欢这个公园，因为它就在附近。我累了就在板凳上休息。公园是我放学后最喜欢的地方。
